propositions: The bugfix-size attestation gate blocks large bug fixes (>150 non-test lines) unless signed by a pinned environment in trusted_environments.yaml, but no developer environment is pinned by default, making the criterion unsatisfiable for contributors
The gate rejects attestations from unpinned DSSE principals with an affirmative mismatch verdict that classifies as FLAG/BLOCK, even when the plan review genuinely passed and was properly signed
The op-cert service has no client in the repository and cannot persist attestation records, so there is no executable path for developers to obtain prod-attested plan reviews
The current design gates on the source of certification (WHO signed via environment pinning) rather than on the fact of a completed, valid plan review (THAT a review happened)
Subject binding (ticket ID and kind validation) must be re-asserted explicitly after removing provenance-chain verification, since it was the sole responsibility of the deleted verify_opcert function
